CREATURE/GOBLINSHREDDERMOUNT/GOBLINSHRED.note: I-364: the client HANGS whenever this mesh plays a combat animation. Confirmed with `.morph 31484` and attacking on foot, so no vehicle is involved. Cause: sequences 5 and 6 (Attack1H) are flagged 0x40 ALIAS with no 0x20 PRIMARY bit, pointing at sequence 54 -- which is flagged 0x0 (neither primary nor alias) and whose aliasNext is ITSELF. Alias resolution therefore never reaches a sequence that claims to own the data. Both attacks in fact carry their own data (52 bones/940 keyframes and 51/835), and so does 54 (54/612), so the repair is simply to stop lying about it: mark them primary, exactly as stock 3.3.5 does (0x21). Keeps the Nexus HD mesh -- Blizzard never updated this model's geometry (1484 verts in stock, Cata AND current retail; the HD pack is 6613), so a retail retroport cannot provide the HD look. globalFlags 0x90 -> 0x10 matches stock's flag word.

CREATURE/ZEPSHREDDERMOUNT/ZEPSHREDDERMOU.note: Same HD mesh byte-for-byte under the I-248 self-contained path (display 26559, Bilgewater Buccaneer). Identical repair.
